newsitems.title: Launch Scale Test Comes to a Close: What's Next?
newsitems.author: nc_community
newsitems.contents: [p]Greetings Daevas,  [/p][p][/p][p]The Launch Scale Test has officially come to a close. We appreciate everyone who took time to try AION 2 and provide valuable feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3]After the Test[/h3][list][*][p][b]Steam players[/b] must uninstall the Playtest App and download AION 2 separately for Advanced Access on September 30th.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PURPLE players[/b] have no further steps needed.[/p][/*][*][p]As an anti-bot measure, direct player-to-player trades are disabled. The Market remains our central hub for trading between players.[/p][/*][*][p]We've updated our queue policy. When a server is at capacity, members in good standing join the priority queue instead of the general queue, and both queues move as space opens. Priority queue access is a privilege, not a guarantee. Players with disciplinary action taken against their account, or accounts suspected of violating the Terms of Service, may have this privilege revoked.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]What's Next?[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth="241,"][tr][th colwidth="241"][p]Advanced Access[/p][/th][td][p]September 30th - October 4th[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="241"][p]Official Launch[/p][/th][td][p]October 5th[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Prepare for Launch[/h3][olist][*][p]Wishlist on Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393110/AION_2/"]\[Steam Store Page][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Buy a Founder's Pack for Advanced Access: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3393110?emclan=103582791475596239&emgid=677375815308020017"]\[Founder's Pack Showcase][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Join the community before launch: [url="https://discord.gg/aion2official"]\[Discord][/url][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Atreia eagerly awaits your return![/p]

newsitems.title: AION 2 Hot Fix Update
newsitems.author: nc_community
newsitems.contents: [p]A hotfix will be applied to address the following issues:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased interaction radius for quest interaction objects[/p][/*][*][p]Characters below level 10 can no longer use appearance change tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an error where chat/macro reporting incorrectly stated that the other party's information could not be verified[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed client crash issues[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Please make sure to download the hotfix before Launch Scale Test Day 2 begins.[/p]
